steps.label: entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat bkpc? > bk2.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q bk2.tgz)" = f2f6dce905b052d9f5b94c24181eb7e3 ] && rm -rf bk && tar xzf bk2.tgz && for f in bk/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls bk/bundle | wc -l

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render bk/bundle P bk_out2.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk_out2.mp4 -i bk/mixm.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest bk_film2.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk_film2.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 26 -c:a aac -b:a 160k bk2_720.mp4 && ls -l bk_film2.mp4 bk2_720.mp4 > bk_done2.txt
